question: Is the heterogeneous real-byte maintenance R1 negative caused by calibrated-monitor target-ranking confusion rather than by inadequate canonical repair or validation semantics?
hypothesis: Across the exact frozen two fresh blobs, four degradation classes, target schedule, and eight cycles from heterogeneous maintenance R1, every true target's exact canonical restoration will improve validation selected-key accuracy by at least 0.20 and restore exact canonical audit behavior, while one or more cycles will rank a non-target key above the true damaged key under the unchanged calibrated excess-error score. If so, classify the R1 failure as monitor-only; otherwise identify repair/validation or interaction failure.
authority: diagnostic research-only; no monitor, threshold, target schedule, corpus, degradation, repair, validation, or capacity changes
frozen_reuse: exact class order and target schedule
exact calibrated background and diagnostic score
exact 0.20 selected-key gain and 0.005 BPB retain thresholds
diagnostic_outputs: true-target calibrated score and rank for every cycle
policy-selected key and whether it equals true target
exact true-target canonical repair selected-key validation gain
exact true-target canonical repair global BPB delta
per-class top1 target count and maximum target rank

attribution_classification.monitor_only: All exact-target repair/audit thresholds pass and calibrated monitor top1 target count is <8.
attribution_classification.repair_or_validation: At least one exact-target repair fails the unchanged retain rule or exact audit restoration.
attribution_classification.mixed: Both monitor misranking and exact-target repair/validation failure occur.
attribution_classification.no_failure_reproduced: All eight true targets rank top1 and all exact repairs pass, contradicting R1 failure.
attribution_classification.invalid: Any frozen identity, schedule, degradation, score, or diagnostic construction drifts.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: No scientific or diagnostic design field may change after any attribution output is observed.
